name: Short-Stay Residence Permit (Kort Verblijf)

requirements.blocker_text: Must submit a short-stay residence permit application to the Immigration Service (Immigratiedienst Curacao / Admission Office); sub-categories include general visitors, wealthy investors/'snowbirds', remote workers, employees, and maritime crew.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source reviewed (a distinct short-stay/temporary category, as opposed to the longer-term permits in this dataset)

sources.title: Immigratiedienst Curacao (Curacao Immigration Service) -- Kort Verblijf (Short Stay): lists visitor, investor, remote-worker, employee, and maritime-crew sub-categories

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Curacao's initial build -- the first constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands built this session, architecturally distinct from both sovereign states and British Overseas Territories: Curacao is autonomous in immigration matters under its own National Ordinance Admission and Deportation (Landsverordening Toelating en Uitzetting, LTU), but its 'citizenship' outcome is Dutch nationality, administered by the Kingdom-level IND (Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst), not a separate Curacao nationality (see cw_naturalisation.json). The Immigration Service's own short-stay landing page did not itemise nationality-specific visa requirements, fees, or exact validity periods -- these likely exist on further linked pages not retrieved in this pass, so this route is modelled at a general level with the gap flagged rather than guessed. Persons who are Dutch nationals born in the former Netherlands Antilles have unrestricted entry/residency rights per the immigration FAQ, and are not subject to this route at all.
